description: Source code for Bluetooth Mesh health client shell commands in Zephyr OS, including fault management, period, and attention settings.

methods.name: show_faults
methods.description: Displays fault information for a given test ID and company ID.

methods.name: cmd_fault_get
methods.description: Handles the 'fault-get' shell command to retrieve faults.

methods.name: fault_clear
methods.description: Clears faults, either acknowledged or unacknowledged.

methods.name: cmd_fault_clear
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for fault_clear with acknowledgment.

methods.name: cmd_fault_clear_unack
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for fault_clear without acknowledgment.

methods.name: fault_test
methods.description: Performs a fault test, either acknowledged or unacknowledged.

methods.name: cmd_fault_test
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for fault_test with acknowledgment.

methods.name: cmd_fault_test_unack
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for fault_test without acknowledgment.

methods.name: cmd_period_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current health period divisor.

methods.name: period_set
methods.description: Sets the health period divisor, acknowledged or unacknowledged.

methods.name: cmd_period_set
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for setting period with acknowledgment.

methods.name: cmd_period_set_unack
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for setting period without acknowledgment.

methods.name: cmd_attention_get
methods.description: Retrieves the current health attention timer.

methods.name: attention_set
methods.description: Sets the health attention timer, acknowledged or unacknowledged.

methods.name: cmd_attention_set
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for setting attention with acknowledgment.

methods.name: cmd_attention_set_unack
methods.description: Shell command wrapper for setting attention without acknowledgment.
